title: The same workflow hardened the normal way: the same action by the same owner, pinned from a tag to the commit it points to, nothing else changed (clean control)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import re
t = open(".github/workflows/ci.yml").read()
assert re.search(r"uses: acme-org/setup-tool@[0-9a-f]{40}  # v2.4.0", t) and "curl" not in t and "contents: read" in t and "write" not in t

PYEND
